content: If you experience any issues with your current dosing schedule, consult your doctor or pharmacist immediately to receive a revised dosing plan. Storage Instructions: Refer to the product's instructions and consult your pharmacist for specific storage guidelines. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it has expired or is no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your individual health requirements. Formulary Information: Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same category. To access formulary details, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider.
